questions: Does steering_oscillation fall below 0.10 on the slalom and s-bend at y=0.05 m?
Is line_loss_events 0 on the s-bend and slalom? If not, at what max_error?
Does the s-bend progress stay at or above about 0.10, or does it fall back to the 0.04 level?
Does the oval still stop at progress 0.115 with max_error near 0.061 m? If so, please confirm it is unaffected by sensor row position.
feedback_request.requested_changes_if_any: If steering_oscillation is still above 0.10 at y=0.05 m, the lead is not the cause, so tell me and I will try wheel_radius 0.04 m next. If the score is above 51.3 with zero line loss, keep y=0.05 m and test y=0.055 m next.

intent: Test whether the 0.05 m forward row keeps steering jitter below 0.10 and removes the s-bend line loss, while the other geometry stays fixed. This follows the Integrator's pre-agreed rule for oscillation above 0.10 at y=0.06 m.
learning: Iteration 4 (36.81) shows the y=0.06 m lead brought back s-bend line loss and slalom oscillation of 0.14, so the lead is only useful up to about 0.07 m if it is not too aggressive. Iteration 3 (y=0.07 m) gave the best score, so the score is not monotonic in lead and the seed spread on the s-bend is wide. Test y=0.05 m next and compare the s-bend and slalom columns separately.
rationale:
Iteration 4 scored 36.81, below iteration 3's 51.31. The s-bend progress fell back to 0.0495 with 0.9 line-loss events per run, which is close to the iteration 0 to 2 level of 0.04. Slalom progress held at 0.0995, so the lead still helps the slalom. Slalom steering_oscillation stayed at 0.141, above the 0.10 threshold the Integrator set. The oval is unchanged at progress 0.115 and max_error 0.061 m across iterations 1 to 4, so sensing, mass, track width and lead do not move it. That points to a fixed feature of that track, not something I can fix in geometry.

The Integrator's rule says that if oscillation stays above 0.10 at y=0.06 m, return the sensor row to y=0.05 m with wheel_track 0.09 m. The oscillation condition is met, and the s-bend line losses came back at y=0.06 m, so I follow that rule. I change only the sensor row, from y=0.06 m to y=0.05 m. Spread (+/-0.05 m), 16 mm footprints, wheel_track 0.09 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, body and mass stay as they were, so the race isolates the lead change.

Expected result: steering_oscillation falls below 0.10 on the slalom and s-bend, line_loss_events on the s-bend drops toward 0, and the score recovers toward the iteration 3 level or a little under it, because some bend progress may be lost with less lead. I do not expect the oval to change. Wheel_radius 0.04 m, the speed lever the Integrator proposed, stays untested for now so it does not confound this change.
